item.title: Crumbl CEO values family time, closes Sundays for work-life balance
item.description: Crumbl cofounder Jason McGowan says closing on Sundays is about balance, not just faith, for his billion-dollar cookie company.

item.title: Rising costs of social venues leave Americans with fewer places to gather
item.description: Chronic isolation is as harmful to health as smoking 15 cigarettes a day.

item.title: SpaceX's record IPO fuels new wave of space startups
item.description: Despite a recent stock dip, SpaceX's IPO is paving the way for more space ventures.

item.title: Most billionaires practice slow philanthropy. MacKenzie Scott gave away $26 billion and won't stop until the safe is empty.
item.description: While most billionaires see their wealth grow faster than their giving, Scott has shown a different approach is possible.
